Sanskrit-first: technical terms held (sattarka, dvaitādhivāsa, śaktipāta, codanā, akiṃcitkara); the twelve-fold kalana steps kept in order (u38). Rows: 1 (question-answer gait: nanu/maivam), 9 (verdicts line-final: na kiṃcit, akiṃcitkara), 2 (catalogues kept whole: śakti-names, kalana-ops), 6 (imperative close: ācaret). lines: themselves as bound; that misapprehension is
the chain that stops saṃsāra — so a counter-pair
concept arises and tears the concept that causes
saṃsāra: the cause of rising good.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tathā hi vikalpabalāt eva jantavo baddham ātmānam abhimanyante sa abhimānaḥ saṃsārapratibandhahetuḥ ataḥ pratidvandvirūpo vikalpa uditaḥ saṃsārahetuṃ vikalpaṃ dalayati iti abhyudayahetuḥ

reads_against.argmap: How does vikalpa both bind and free? → The same instrument binds or frees: pair-opposed vikalpa dissolves the binding one.
c1_essence: By concept-strength beings mistake themselves bound; the counter-pair concept tears that cause and becomes prosperity's cause.
reads_against.c1_rasa: karuṇā with vīrya weight (compassion carrying fierce argument)
